text:
sara: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners + short dates for headroom playbook, quota guardrails, scheduler tweaks, and recurring validation runs. Keep replies short.

miguel: I'll take quota guardrails. Deliver a short API + enforcement spec (per-customer burst caps, 5m credit bucket, admin override). Target: Tue EOD (1981310000).

kevin: Scheduler tuning on me. I'll run two staged experiments: memory-weighted bin-packing and region-aware node reservation. Will post numbers by Thu (1981482800).

ashley: I'll write the headroom runbook + comms templates. Include dedicated-customer exemptions and auto-rollout pause at 25% spare. Draft Fri (1981569200).

dmitri: Ops automation: ops-bot will post daily spare_gpu snapshots and create REM ticket when spare_gpus < 15% for 15m. Prototype alert + ticket flow by next Mon (1981702800).

lia: To catch recurring incident patterns, I'll add a weekly regression check that runs a 10m controlled spike and records headroom impact. Will prototype dashboard query by Wed.

sara: Good. Add a 48h validation after any remediation and tie it to the REM ticket closure. Also add a permanent doc section: "lessons observed" for recurring triggers.

miguel: One ask: add a soft throttle on new large model rollouts when region spare_gpus < 30%. I'll include in the quota spec.

kevin: Noted. Small config I'll test in staging (pseudo): desiredHeadroom: 0.18; binPacking.weightMemory: 1.5; rolloutPauseThreshold: 0.25.

ops-bot: reminder-created: "Headroom remediation weekly sync" every Mon 09:30 in #incidents. first_run_ts: 1981286400. jira-created: REM-12100 assigned-to: miguel, REM-12101 assigned-to: kevin, REM-12102 assigned-to: ashley.

sara: Owners summary: quota - miguel (Tue 1981310000); scheduler - kevin (Thu 1981482800); runbook - ashley (Fri 1981569200); alerts - dmitri (Mon 1981702800); regression checks - lia (Wed 1981396400). Close thread once REM tickets have PR links and initial drafts are posted.

kevin: I'll post staging logs and perf deltas here when ready.

miguel: Will include a short FAQ for sales/admin overrides in the spec.

sara: Thanks all. We'll review during the weekly checkpoint. :thumbsup:
